changelog:
- Experimental Mozilla GeckoView Engine (Firefox Quantum): Direct native rendering engine testing with built-in Content Blocking and anti-tracking.
- Native YouTube & Social Ad Elimination: Raw network stream filtering independent of Android System WebView restrictions.
- Preserved 100% Native Fokk UI: Tab switcher, search pill, bottom nav, downloads, and dual deck view remain identical.
- Lightweight ARM64 Target: Optimized ABI packaging keeps app responsive and fast.
